<observations>
Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User stated kitchen remodel budget is $28,500; demo scheduled for June 5.
* 🔴 (09:00) User wants larger oven space for Italian cooking and added a pull-out trash bin.
* 🟡 (12:45) Agent scheduled virtual walkthrough with BrightBuild Co. and compiled countertop quotes.
* ✅ (19:35) Countertop quotes compiled; revised quote package emailed to user.

Date: May 16, 2026
* 🔴 (07:20) User added under-cabinet LED strips, upgraded range hood to 900 CFM, and changed backsplash tile to Sea Glass.
* 🟡 (09:30) Agent ordered 120ft LED strips (BrightGlow) and logged VentMaster hood quote ($2,750).
* ✅ (13:15) VentMaster hood quote received ($2,750); quartz windowsill mock-up PDF sent to user.

Date: May 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected matte black AquaFlow faucet, postponed demolition pending flooring arrival, and inquired about an island wine cooler.
* 🟡 (08:55) Agent ordered 2 sets of faucets (PlumbPro) and updated permit checklist for upcoming HOA meeting.
* ✅ (11:15) Quartz countertop slabs shipping confirmed from StoneEdge Fabricators (ETA June 5).

Date: May 22, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User measured backsplash as 12.5 sq ft, selected Honey Oak Classic engineered flooring (FloorCraft), and chose Soft Sand paint for upper cabinets.
* 🟡 (09:25) Agent scheduled electrical rough-in for June 3 with Marco Ruiz and ordered paint.
* ✅ (12:20) MarbleMist tile sample received; HOA approved remodel permit.

Date: May 26, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User reported 9 ft 2 in ceiling height, selected Cascade Ridge quartzite island edge, and confirmed AquaPure 24 sink replacement.
* 🟡 (09:45) Agent ordered 18 sq m quartzite (EdgeCraft, ETA July 15), rescheduled demo to June 20 (Luis Ortega), and ordered 36-in sliding glass pantry panels (VistaGlide).
* ✅ (13:15) Electrical permit amendment for additional outlets approved.

Date: May 30, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User confirmed 9 ft 4 in island length, selected Midnight Slate quartzite (RiverStone, ETA Aug 5), FlowMaster Nimbus faucet ($185), frosted glass pantry panel (4x6 ft, ClearView), Vintner 24 wine cooler, and cabinet delivery for July 2.
* 🟡 (11:10) Agent scheduled EcoFlow Plumbing for sink install on July 18 and updated lighting (LuxeLights pendant) and electrical plans.
* ✅ (13:30) Revised electrical layout received from Miller & Co. showing two additional GFCI outlets.
</observations>

<current-task>
Primary: Managing kitchen remodel selections, scheduling deliveries (cabinets July 2, quartzite July 15/August 5), and coordinating upcoming contractor work (demolition June 20, plumbing July 18).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've updated the master schedule and material tracking with your latest selections, including the Midnight Slate quartzite, Vintner 24 wine cooler, and new pantry panel details. Would you like to review the updated timeline for July installations?"
</suggested-response>
